clippings.speaker: Jamie Foxx
clippings.quote: “He says, ‘What are you doing?’” Foxx remembers of that day on set. “I say, ‘I’m trying to do my thing, Mike.’ He says, ‘How about you don’t do your thing. When was the last time you saw a guy who drove a taxi cab do his thing? He’s trying to get home because he’s tired. … So why don’t you be real.’”
clippings.title: How Jamie Foxx drew on lessons from Michael Mann for death row drama 'Just Mercy'
clippings.context: Promoting Just Mercy, Foxx recalls Mann cutting a scene short on Collateral to stop him performing.

clippings.speaker: Jamie Foxx
clippings.quote: Michael Mann, who's known for his intensity, but we had a great chemistry on this film. I think it has something to do with being in LA. We felt really comfortable doing it.

clippings.speaker: Jamie Foxx
clippings.quote: Now this is like my thing I've been lucky enough to have. I was thrown Michael Mann, Tom Cruise saying we believe. You've got to have somebody who believes that you can actually make it happen.
